value.name: export
value.description: Download this Session log as a ZIP archive

value.name: goal
value.description: Set or view the goal for a long-running task

value.name: permission
value.description: Switch the permission preset (sandbox mode + approval policy)

commands_list.note: session-composed roster; the exact set depends on the Host's plugins and the Session preset. Each row is {definitionId?, name, description, input?:{hint, attachments?}}

skills_list.note: empty on this Host; each entry is {path?, name, description, whenToUse?, modelInvocable}

file_references_list.note: composer @ candidates; a directory carries kind 'directory' and is opened with a quoted token (@"dir/") so the path can contain spaces

execute_unknown.note: the Host answers ok with no value because it did not claim the line; the composer then sends it as an ordinary prompt

order.subscribe: the / trigger source 'command' (host roster + client contributions) and source 'skill' (skills/list) share one popup, commands first
order.client_contribution: the built-in /file row (label 添加文件, action → open file dialog) comes from the conversation plugin, after the host roster
order.leading_vs_inline: a leading '/' offers every row; an inline '/name' offers only commands without an input hint
order.invalidation: commands/change invalidates the roster; agent-preset/selected resets a Session
